import blended.ops as ops

# ---- Parameters (all named, all reasons in the comments) ----
width_m = 1.2      # overall width -> 'wide rectangular' unit
height_m = 0.75     # overall height
depth_m = 0.28      # overall depth (typical shelf depth)
cols = 3             # columns of compartments
rows = 2             # rows of compartments
bar_t = 0.045        # frame/divider bar thickness (border + between cells)
diag_t = 0.015       # thickness of each diagonal cross-brace strip
overshoot = 0.02     # cutter overshoot so through-cuts are unambiguous

cell_w = (width_m - (cols + 1) * bar_t) / cols
cell_h = (height_m - (rows + 1) * bar_t) / rows
assert cell_w > 0 and cell_h > 0

frame_name = "ShelfUnit"
ops.add_box(name=frame_name, width_m=width_m, depth_m=depth_m, height_m=height_m, location_m=[0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
ops.link_into_scene(object_name=frame_name)

cell_centers = []
for r in range(rows):
    bottom_r = bar_t + r * (cell_h + bar_t)
    zc = bottom_r + cell_h / 2.0
    for c in range(cols):
        left_c = -width_m / 2.0 + bar_t + c * (cell_w + bar_t)
        xc = left_c + cell_w / 2.0
        cell_centers.append((xc, zc, bottom_r))
        cutter_name = f"Cutter_{r}_{c}"
        ops.add_box(name=cutter_name, width_m=cell_w, depth_m=depth_m + 2 * overshoot, height_m=cell_h,
                    location_m=[xc, 0.0, bottom_r])
        ops.boolean_difference(target_name=frame_name, cutter_name=cutter_name)

def build_diag_prism(name, x0, z0, x1, z1, thick, y_min, y_max):
    dx, dz = x1 - x0, z1 - z0
    L = math.hypot(dx, dz)
    ux, uz = dx / L, dz / L
    nx, nz = -uz, ux
    hx, hz = nx * thick / 2.0, nz * thick / 2.0
    p = [
        (x0 + hx, z0 + hz), (x0 - hx, z0 - hz),
        (x1 - hx, z1 - hz), (x1 + hx, z1 + hz),
    ]
    bm = bmesh.new()
    v_lo = [bm.verts.new((px, y_min, pz)) for (px, pz) in p]
    v_hi = [bm.verts.new((px, y_max, pz)) for (px, pz) in p]
    bm.verts.ensure_lookup_table()
    bm.faces.new((v_lo[0], v_lo[1], v_lo[2], v_lo[3]))
    bm.faces.new((v_hi[3], v_hi[2], v_hi[1], v_hi[0]))
    for i in range(4):
        j = (i + 1) % 4
        bm.faces.new((v_lo[i], v_lo[j], v_hi[j], v_hi[i]))
    bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm, faces=bm.faces[:])
    me = bpy.data.meshes.new(name + "_mesh")
    bm.to_mesh(me)
    bm.free()
    obj = bpy.data.objects.new(name, me)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(obj)
    return obj.name

diag_names = []
y_min, y_max = -depth_m / 2.0, depth_m / 2.0
for idx, (xc, zc, bottom_r) in enumerate(cell_centers):
    x0, x1 = xc - cell_w / 2.0, xc + cell_w / 2.0
    z0, z1 = zc - cell_h / 2.0, zc + cell_h / 2.0
    nA = build_diag_prism(f"Diag_{idx}_A", x0, z0, x1, z1, diag_t, y_min, y_max)
    nB = build_diag_prism(f"Diag_{idx}_B", x0, z1, x1, z0, diag_t, y_min, y_max)
    diag_names.append(nA)
    diag_names.append(nB)

for dn in diag_names:
    ops.boolean_union(target_name=frame_name, addend_name=dn)

bpy.context.view_layer.update()
fobj = bpy.data.objects[frame_name]
corners = [fobj.matrix_world @ __import__('mathutils').Vector(c) for c in fobj.bound_box]
xs = [c.x for c in corners]; ys = [c.y for c in corners]; zs = [c.z for c in corners]
print('cells:', len(cell_centers), 'diagonals:', len(diag_names))
print('world extents x,y,z:', max(xs)-min(xs), max(ys)-min(ys), max(zs)-min(zs))
print('z min (should be ~0):', min(zs))
print('scene object count:', len(bpy.context.scene.objects))
